description: Curated CDS Hooks card indicators for the decisions of the WHO SMART ANC decision tables used by the pilot. The WHO PlanDefinitions set no priority on any action, so without this overlay every card would be 'info'. Decisions are identified by the PlanDefinition canonical URL and the action title (the card summary).

actions.title: Proceed with ANC contact
actions.rationale: No danger signs: the contact continues as normal.

actions.title: Proceed with ANC contact OR Referral for Central cyanosis
actions.rationale: Danger sign: the woman needs urgent management or referral before the contact goes on.

actions.title: Proceed with ANC contact OR Referral
actions.rationale: Danger sign: the woman needs urgent management or referral before the contact goes on.

actions.title: No syphilis test required
actions.rationale: Known syphilis: no test; the treatment is part of the known diagnosis.

actions.title: Refer urgently to a hospital
actions.rationale: Severe hypertension, pre-eclampsia or severe pre-eclampsia: urgent referral.

actions.title: Conduct hypertension counselling
actions.rationale: Abnormal finding (hypertension) that requires counselling before the woman leaves.

actions.title: Conduct REQUIRED gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) counselling
Conduct REQUIRED anaemia counselling
actions.rationale: Anaemia: required counselling and a higher iron dose.

actions.title: "Anaemia counselling conducted" IS OPTIONAL
actions.rationale: No anaemia: routine iron and folic acid supplementation.
